title: GVNF common definitions
description: Shared $defs reused across GVNF schemas (GalForge Visual-Novel Format v1.0).

position.description: Stage slot. At most two characters visible at once (script-standard §6).

text.description: Displayable text. A leading '@' marks an i18n key (e.g. '@s01.aoi.001'); '@@' escapes a literal '@'; any other string is inline literal prose.

transition.description: A transition effect (script-standard §7). A bare string is sugar for { type: <string> }.

assignments.description: Variable assignments. Value: literal (bool/number/string), relative ('+2'/'-1'), or expression ('=expr').

jumpTarget.description: Scene id ('s02'), in-scene label ('#join'), or scene+label ('s02#intro').
